role: development-only paired receiver-supervised carrier training; not a physics PINN or independent validation
analysis: Initialize two identical wavefield heads with the same frozen learned eikonal network; train on identical 29-source batches, changing only learned vs reciprocal-FMM travel-time input. Evaluate full and FD-active waveform error and x/y/z displacement response on twelve previously inspected directional development records, with source truth used for forward evaluation only. Do not feed these events into training or claim this as a full-domain source inversion.
limits: FMM 80 m reciprocal fields snap receivers by up to 60 m; no PDE/IC/BC loss, no gradients through continuous FMM source coordinates, no new held-out test, no localization or geoscientific performance claim.
